run: qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-desktop-note" and .state == "loaded")] | length'
horneroctl plugin remove example-desktop-note --yes >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo removed || echo refused

python3 -c "import json,subprocess; cli=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['horneroctl','plugin','list','--json'],text=True)); raw=cli['data']['plugins']; ps=json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw,str) else raw; print(str(all(p['id']!='example-desktop-note' for p in ps)).lower())"
qs ipc call plugins reload >/dev/null 2>&1; qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '[.plugins[] | select(.id == "example-desktop-note")] | length'
qs ipc call plugins status | jq -r '"\(.loaded >= 1) \(.failed)"'
